targets.baseline_commit_message: fine-tune-a-small-model-on-a-persons-rules: the decider-laws-finetune build, train, score and model code, moved byte for byte

preserve: lines split by source before any training: guide lines by (file, nearest heading), spoken by halves, captions by video
one seeded random generator draws every sample in the old order, so the same request makes the same rows byte for byte
never-train and held-out lines are never trained on; a synthetic line that is a test line is dropped
a line some law rules bad is never also a good line; a line bad only for another law is not a label
each law trains on other laws' synthetic good lines and on short good lines, except the laws and kinds named
allowed_deltas: the laws, set names, never-train lines, paths and counts are the request's (the person's settings row), not constants
guides are read in sorted order, so a line found in two guides is grouped the same on every computer
the answer is one JSON line after the old summary lines
banned_substitutions: a second copy of this job beside the old one
the person's laws, lines, paths or counts written in code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it. Lines 57-196 are its functions (the constants above them are the person's settings and moved to their list:settings row), less the five lines that name the person (90, 95, 136, 140, 144); the first range is the byte copy.
